verdict.rationale: LiveKit's pricing page offers a preview of the per-minute cost to run an agent on LiveKit Cloud, which points to published usage-based pricing a founder could model without sales. However, the evidence shows no actual rates and nothing priced per participant-minute or per unit of bandwidth. Missing for 10: published per-participant-minute rates, per-GB bandwidth or egress rates, concrete price figures, and independent confirmation that costs can be modeled without contacting sales.

support.subject: As a founder, usage pricing is published per participant-minute or per unit of bandwidth, so I can model cost without talking to sales

citations.quote: Preview the per-minute cost to run an agent on LiveKit Cloud.
